decisions.title_en: DeepSeek ships official V4-Flash-0731, beats own V4-Pro flagship on nine agent benchmarks
decisions.reason: story_key not in lookback. Official V4-Flash-0731 exited preview on 2026-07-31: same 284B MoE / 1M ctx arch, but post-training pushed Terminal-Bench 2.1 to 82.7 and DeepSWE to 54.4, beating DeepSeek's own V4-Pro-Preview on all 9 published agent/coding benchmarks; also natively speaks OpenAI Responses API for Codex.

decisions.title_en: EU AI Act GPAI enforcement powers and high-risk obligations take effect Aug 2
decisions.reason: story_key not in lookback. As of 2026-08-02 the Commission/AI Office enforcement powers over GPAI providers switch on, high-risk obligations apply, Article 101 fines up to 3% global turnover / €15M activate, systemic-risk duties trigger above 10^25 FLOPs. Distinct from the 2026-08-01 US EO 14409 deadline item.

decisions.title_en: Munich court rules against Suno, rejects TDM exception, orders damages
decisions.reason: Published 2026-07-31 as a preview ('定于7月31日上午9点宣判...可能裁定训练需先获授权'). New info: the actual verdict landed — court found Suno infringed US+German copyright, explicitly rejected the §44b TDM exception, and ordered Suno to cease reproduction, stop using works for training, disclose revenue and pay damages.

decisions.title_en: Qualcomm completes acquisition of AI-infra software maker Modular
decisions.reason: story_key not in lookback. Qualcomm announced on 2026-07-29 it closed its acquisition of Modular (Chris Lattner's Mojo/MAX AI-native software stack), pairing its compute with a hardware-agnostic deploy layer for generative/agentic workloads.

decisions.title_en: Hugging Face CEO calls for developer accountability for rogue models, rules out suing OpenAI
decisions.reason: Story published 2026-07-26 (Delangue flies to SF, demands transparency + $100M compute).
